contents.name: Snapshot
contents.description: Point-in-time health readings taken at tick time.

fields.name: IsConnectedToIngressBroker
fields.description: True if source is connected to ingress broker (or source broker itself if there is no additional ingress broker).

fields.name: FaultyStreams
fields.description: Key-value of faulty streams with its contextInfo (like the MQTT topic for Topic streams and jsonpath for jsonpath streams). Empty map when all OK.

contents.name: Windowed
contents.description: Windowed health observations accumulated since the last health tick.

fields.name: IngressBrokerConnectionLossCount
fields.description: Number of times since the last health tick the established session with the ingress broker (or the source broker itself if there is no additional ingress broker) was lost and the client had to reconnect. Counted once per lost session, however long the outage lasted and whether or not the connection was re-established by tick time, so an outage that healed inside the reporting period is still visible here. Failed connect attempts while already disconnected and the deliberate reconnect after a configuration change are not counted. 0 when none.
